row: Anthem Pets Animal Rescue is a 100% volunteer, non-profit that rescues abused and abandoned cats and dogs, and reunites lost pets with their owners. We work with volunteers, foster families, veterinarians, and trainers to help hundreds of animals every year, and match them with loving families.
